**Visual Analysis of Test Image:**
- Wheat head (spike) with individual spikelets visible
- Several spikelets show distinctive **orange/salmon bleaching** 
- Affected spikelets are fully bleached with an orange-tan color
- Surrounding spikelets remain healthy green
- Classic "partial head bleaching" pattern — only some spikelets affected

**Differential Diagnosis:**
- **Head_Scab (Fusarium Head Blight)**: Exactly matches — premature bleaching of individual spikelets with orange/salmon coloration, while adjacent spikelets remain green. This is the hallmark presentation.
- **Loose_Smut**: Would show dark sooty/black spore masses replacing kernels
- **Dwarf_Bunt**: Would show dark bunt balls in place of grain
- **Stripe_Rust**: Would show yellow stripe pustules on leaf surfaces

The orange-tan bleached spikelets interspersed among green spikelets on a wheat head is the textbook presentation of Head Scab (Fusarium Head Blight).
